findings.evidence: proposal.md lists "the push remote path when local" among the denyWrite entries. In template/scripts/sandboxed_writer.py, launch_sandboxed_writer calls build_profile with only protected_paths(integration_root) and platform_root. extra_deny_write is never populated, and protected_paths covers only the root, the common git dir and the worktrees. A local-path origin outside those directories is writable only if it lies outside the allowWrite roots. Nothing in the profile denies it explicitly, and no test covers it.
findings.summary: The proposal says the profile denies writes to the push remote path when it is local. The launch path never computes or passes that path, so a local bare remote stays outside the deny list.

findings.evidence: spec.md: "The token file location SHALL be read-denied inside the sandbox." build_profile builds deny_read from DENY_READ_HOME, protected and platform only. read_claude_token's path is never added to the profile. Reads are denied only if the file happens to sit under ~/.config/dev-platform. The writer already holds the token in its environment, which limits the impact.
findings.summary: The spec requires the token file location to be read-denied inside the sandbox. The profile only denies reads of fixed home paths, so a token_file outside those paths is not denied.

findings.evidence: In sandboxed_writer.py, launch_sandboxed_writer passes extra_env={TOKEN_ENV: token} to run_llm. The command is [npx, --yes, @anthropic-ai/sandbox-runtime@ver, ...]. npm, and any install script it runs, therefore sees CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN. The version pin has no integrity check, and the design's alternative of checking a resolvable srt binary's --version is not implemented.
findings.summary: The token is in the environment of the outer `npx --yes` process. That process downloads and runs a package outside the sandbox. The inner command could instead receive the token, with the outer process left without it.

findings.evidence: sandboxed_writer.py srt_tmp: `if not path.exists(): path.mkdir(mode=0o700)` followed by an lstat check of the owner and S_ISDIR only. A pre-existing directory with a wider mode is accepted, and a concurrent launch can hit FileExistsError.
findings.summary: srt_tmp checks the owner of the shared /private/tmp/dp-srt-<uid> directory but not its mode. It also checks existence before creating, which leaves a race.

findings.evidence: sandboxed_writer.py line 305 defines SAFE_GIT. harness_git in lifecycle_workers.py uses its own SAFE_GIT.
findings.summary: SAFE_GIT is redefined in the new module. lifecycle_workers.py already has the same constant, and the two copies can drift.
